title: Leo — charm, nerves and a questionable past
userDirection: Leo is the selected voice. The existing restrained recordings are acceptable as part of his range. Add emotional variety, charm, gentle warmth, dark humour and some adult edge. Relevance and intelligibility remain mandatory.
synthesisDirection: Audition supported speech tags for actual vocal performance: warmth, reluctant affection, surprise, urgency, relief and restrained laughter. No voice substitution or pitch processing. Emotional acting is specific to the scene; he does not laugh, whisper or swear on every event.

performanceMix.principle: Keep the original restrained takes in the pool. Add emotional readings only when they match the actual situation.
rules: Discovery: recognition, affection, or uneasy familiarity.
Immediate danger: short, alert and intelligible.
After real danger: relief or an occasional gallows joke.
Adult language is occasional character colour; never a random trigger.
A laugh or breath belongs to the performance of one moment; it is not a recurring sound effect.
The original rarity, freshness, no-overlap and anti-repeat rules still apply.

clips.delivery: Warm recognition, as if he missed something he thought was gone.
clips.intent: Hear a feeling behind the memory without adding exposition.

clips.delivery: Quiet recognition followed by a small weary sigh.
clips.intent: The familiarity costs him something; this is not a neutral announcement.

clips.delivery: Release a breath, then a small disbelieving smile through the words.

clips.delivery: A pleased discovery followed by a knowingly bad decision.

clips.excludeOverride: Never for a short surface loop, shop entry, underground teleport, or a menu.
